findings.message: The diff adds a second control for the same `statsWindow` value: `statsInput`, the Settings `Stats window` select. Its change handler copies its value into `windowSelect`, but the `windowSelect` change listener added on this line calls `persist()` and `loadStats()` without updating `statsInput.value`. If the operator picks `30d` in the Stats section, stats load and `30d` is persisted, but Settings still shows `7d` until the next reboot. The two UI-preference controls then disagree about the active window.
findings.paved_road: In the `windowSelect` change listener, also set `statsInput.value = windowSelect.value` (declare `statsInput` before use or assign it lazily) so both controls always show the persisted `statsWindow`. Add a harness assertion that changing the Stats section select updates the Settings `Stats window` value.
